notes: Minimal example (marked as an example, not a formal case). Point --input at a directory shaped like this to exercise the Skill end to end. It carries one checklist material with a rules block, two check points and one judgment-rule row plus one numbered threshold; the output directory will then contain result.json plus the candidate pool, the anchor table and the grading trace.

# rules
```rules
kw control|control (group|arm)|comparator|placebo
kw effect|95%\s*(CI|confidence interval)|odds ratio|hazard ratio
cp D2|DESIGN|有无明确对照|control|-|Methods|low|-
cp T2|STATSREP|效应量与不确定性|effect|-|Results|low|-
```
| rule | trigger | judgment | risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| `R_J1_ABSTAIN` | no keyword hit | `not_assessable` | `insufficient` |
| `R_J3_MET` | at least two anchors | `met` | `floor` |
1. A dimension with a `major` risk in DESIGN, SAMPLE or BIAS forces the overall `high_risk`.
